# LV24 WiFi Explorer

> Cross-platform Wi-Fi scanner for humans and AI agents. Live CoreWLAN scans on
> macOS, NetworkManager on Linux, `netsh` on Windows, deterministic demo
> fixtures everywhere. MIT packages, a CLI and a stdio MCP server share one
> domain model.

Repository: https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-Wifi-Explorer
Releases: https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-Wifi-Explorer/releases
License: MIT (app code); optional MUI X Pro in the desktop UI.

## Packages (npm 1.0.1)

- `@lv24/wifi-core` — domain, IE decoding, filters, issues, utilization
- `@lv24/wifi-backend` — scan providers: `macos-scancore`, `linux-nmcli`, `windows-netsh`, `demo`
- `@lv24/wifi-cli` — `lv24-wifi` CLI
- `@lv24/wifi-mcp` — MCP stdio server with six Wi-Fi tools

## Install

```bash
npm i -g @lv24/wifi-cli
npx -y @lv24/wifi-mcp
```

macOS desktop app: download the DMG from Releases. Public builds are
watermarked (no MUI key) and not notarized; first launch needs right-click →
Open. Grant Location once to `ScanCore` for real SSID/BSSID.

## MCP server

Command: `npx -y @lv24/wifi-mcp` (stdio). Tools:

- `wifi_providers` — available providers and capability gaps
- `wifi_scan` — active scan; args `provider?`, `ssid?`, `includeHidden?`, `intervalMs?`, `timeoutMs?`, `limit?`, `fields?`
- `wifi_network` — one BSS by `bssid`; `refresh?`
- `wifi_summary` — counts by band/security/vendor, busiest channels, strongest/weakest
- `wifi_channels` — per-channel utilization + beacon-overhead estimate (`estimate: true`)
- `wifi_issues` — heuristic flags (`lowSignal`, `lowSnr`, `weakSecurity`, `hiddenSsid`, `overlap24`, `crowdedChannel`, `dfs`, ...)

Results are cached for 30 s; pass `refresh: true` to rescan. Concurrent calls
are serialized. Demo fixtures: `{"provider": "demo"}`.

Client config (OpenCode):

```json
{
  "mcp": {
    "lv24-wifi": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": ["npx", "-y", "@lv24/wifi-mcp"],
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Desktop / Cursor use the same `mcpServers` shape with
`"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@lv24/wifi-mcp"]`.

macOS live data needs the signed `ScanCore.app`; resolve it with
`LV24_SCANCORE_PATH` or `LV24_RESOURCES_PATH`, or run from the repository where
`native/ScanCore/.build/ScanCore.app` exists.

## CLI

```bash
lv24-wifi providers
lv24-wifi scan --format json
lv24-wifi scan --provider demo --format json
lv24-wifi scan --ssid "Cafe" --format table
```

## Data honesty

- macOS: real SSID/BSSID/channel width/PHY/IEs with Location permission.
- Linux/Windows: RSSI derived from signal quality; channel width, noise and IEs
  are unavailable and reported as unknown.
- Beacon airtime is an estimate, never a measurement.
- Vendor comes from the IEEE MA-L registry when `data/oui/ieee-mal.csv` is
  present; randomized MACs report `null`.
- No telemetry, no cloud upload; scan data stays in process memory.
